hub.seo_title: Everyday AI Workflows: Notes, Plans & Documents | Nolan Kido
hub.description: Choose an everyday task, compare a simple method with optional AI, and use a free worksheet. Seven worked guides for notes, plans, documents, and more.

tasks.label: Organize notes into action items
tasks.seo_title: Organize Notes into Action Items, with Optional AI | Nolan Kido
tasks.description: Turn scattered notes into actions, references, and open questions. Includes a fictional example, an optional AI prompt, and a free text worksheet.

tasks.label: Make a shared plan
tasks.seo_title: Shared Planning Template: Decisions, Owners & Dates | Nolan Kido
tasks.description: Make a shared plan with confirmed details, owners, and open questions. Use the worked guide and free template; keep approval with the people involved.

tasks.label: Find and organize a document
tasks.seo_title: Find and Organize Documents Before Using AI | Nolan Kido
tasks.description: Find, name, and verify one document before asking AI to summarize it. Includes a privacy-conscious workflow and a free document-index template.
tasks.cue: Find the original before asking for a summary.

tasks.label: Turn rough notes into a draft
tasks.seo_title: Turn Rough Notes into a Draft: A Creative Brief | Nolan Kido
tasks.description: Develop a small draft from your own notes without invented memories or claims. Includes a fictional example, optional AI outline prompt, and free creative brief.
tasks.cue: Keep your meaning while improving the draft.

tasks.label: Make digital reading easier
tasks.seo_title: Make Digital Reading Easier: Reader View & Read-Aloud | Nolan Kido
tasks.description: Try text size, reader view, and read-aloud support before adding AI. A practical guide with source checks and a free reading-setup worksheet.
tasks.cue: Use the original text in a format that fits.

tasks.label: Reflect without outsourcing judgment
tasks.seo_title: AI-Assisted Reflection: Prompts with Boundaries | Nolan Kido
tasks.description: Separate observations, interpretations, and choices in a private reflection. Use paper or optional AI questions, with a free worksheet and clear limits.
tasks.cue: Use a notebook first; questions are not verdicts.

tasks.label: Decide whether a workflow helped
tasks.seo_title: Evaluate an AI Workflow: Effort, Quality & Tradeoffs | Nolan Kido
tasks.description: Evaluate an AI or software workflow beyond its first draft: include setup, checking, upkeep, and effects on others. Free keep-or-stop review worksheet.
tasks.cue: Count the full effort and consider more than speed.
